name: tethered-controls
title: Tethered
description: Control Tethered directly from Raycast. Tethered must be installed and running. A number of actions are only available to users with Pro access.
author: Tumerit

commands.name: share-profile
commands.title: Share Profile
commands.description: Choose a saved profile and export a .tetheredprofile file through Tethered

commands.name: post-profile
commands.title: Post Profile
commands.description: Choose a saved profile and open Tethered’s submission editor for tetheredmac.com/profiles

commands.name: toggle-companion-sync
commands.title: Toggle Companion Sync
commands.description: Request a Companion Sync toggle; requires a supporting Tethered app version

commands.name: toggle-mcp-bridge
commands.title: Toggle MCP Bridge
commands.description: Enable or disable the Tethered MCP bridge; disabling ends the active task session

commands.name: manage-events
commands.title: Next Event
commands.description: Show the next upcoming event and open the event manager

commands.name: manage-events-view
commands.title: Manage Events
commands.description: View upcoming events, edit schedules, and enable or disable repeating events

commands.name: quick-event
commands.title: Quick Event
commands.description: Type an event in plain language, preview it live, and press Enter to create it

commands.name: create-scheduled-event
commands.title: Create Scheduled Event
commands.description: Schedule a one-time Tethered action or macOS power event

commands.name: create-repeating-event
commands.title: Create Repeating Event
commands.description: Repeat a Tethered action or macOS power event on selected weekdays

commands.name: get-tethered
commands.title: Get Tethered
commands.description: Open the Tethered website to download the Mac app

commands.name: auto-power
commands.title: Auto Power
commands.description: Set Tethered to Auto Power

commands.name: low-power
commands.title: Low Power
commands.description: Set Tethered to Low Power

commands.name: high-power
commands.title: High Power
commands.description: Set Tethered to High Power

commands.name: start-caffeinate
commands.title: Start Caffeinate
commands.description: Start the default Tethered Caffeinate preset

commands.name: start-timed-caffeinate
commands.title: Start Timed Caffeinate
commands.description: Keep your Mac awake for a chosen number of minutes

commands.name: stop-caffeinate
commands.title: Stop Caffeinate
commands.description: Stop Tethered Caffeinate

commands.name: run-caffeinate-preset
commands.title: Run Caffeinate Preset
commands.description: Browse and run saved Caffeinate presets

commands.name: show-status
commands.title: Show Status
commands.description: Read the current Tethered battery and control state

commands.name: get-tethered-pro
commands.title: Get Tethered Pro
commands.description: Open checkout for Tethered Pro on this Mac

commands.name: start-calibration
commands.title: Start Calibration
commands.description: Start a manual battery calibration cycle

commands.name: cancel-calibration
commands.title: Cancel Calibration
commands.description: Cancel the current battery calibration cycle

commands.name: enable-topup
commands.title: Enable Topup
commands.description: Charge to full with Tethered Topup

commands.name: disable-topup
commands.title: Disable Topup
commands.description: Return to the normal charging limit

commands.name: enable-sailing
commands.title: Enable Sailing
commands.description: Enable Tethered Sailing behavior

commands.name: disable-sailing
commands.title: Disable Sailing
commands.description: Disable Tethered Sailing behavior

commands.name: enable-heat-protection
commands.title: Enable Heat Protection
commands.description: Enable battery temperature protection

commands.name: disable-heat-protection
commands.title: Disable Heat Protection
commands.description: Disable battery temperature protection

commands.name: apply-profile
commands.title: Apply Profile
commands.description: Browse and apply saved Tethered settings profiles
